entityId.description: Lowercase kebab-case stable identifier, unique within its entity type. Same convention as org-doctrine-model's common.schema.json — deliberately not $ref'd across packages, to keep c2-interfaces self-contained (see README).

doctrineSource.description: Citation to the public doctrine or reference material that grounds this message type or record. Required per AGENTS.md Section 2, which explicitly calls out 'a C2 interface' alongside the org/doctrine model and mission scenarios — not optional style.

actor.description: Who produced this message — mirrors org-doctrine-model DoctrineProcess step's actorRoleId/actorC2NodeId/actorOrganizationId pattern (usually exactly one is set).
